description: This PHP source file defines the LoggerDenyAllFilter class, which extends LoggerFilter, and is used to prevent all logging events from being processed by returning a denial constant. It is part of the log4php framework, specifically in the 'varia' subpackage, designed to be added at the end of a filter chain to deny all logging unless explicitly allowed.

classes.name: LoggerDenyAllFilter
classes.description: A filter class that denies all logging events by always returning the LOG4PHP_LOGGER_FILTER_DENY constant.

methods.name: decide
methods.description: Always returns LOG4PHP_LOGGER_FILTER_DENY to reject any logging event.
